config_path.description: Path to the config file (CLI override via -config)

address.description: IP address to bind the server to

port.description: Port to listen on for incoming connections

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for fetching certificate data from CT logs

ctfe_servers.description: List of Certificate Transparency Log servers to monitor. Each entry must include 'url' and may include 'name' and 'enabled'.

verbose.description: Enable verbose logging (includes full certificate content)

pid_file.description: Optional path to write process PID file

ctfe_servers.items.description: Single CT log server entry (used only internally for list item validation; values defined per-item below).
